_source.title: 获取画布原点相对于数据原点的偏移坐标
_source.remarks.text.0: 嘉立创 EDA 专业版前端显示的坐标均为画布原点；
_source.remarks.text.1: 嘉立创 EDA 专业版 API 使用的均为数据原点；
_source.remarks.text.2:
如果返回的数据为 `{ canvasOriginOffsetX: 100, canvasOriginOffsetY: 200 }`，
则代表画布原点在数据原点的向右 100 单位且向上 200 单位的位置；
_source.remarks.text.3: 此处的单位为数据层面单位，在跨度上等同于画布层面的 mil
_source.returns: 画布原点相对于数据原点的偏移坐标

title: Get the offset coordinate of the canvas origin relative to the data origin
remarks.text.0: The coordinates displayed on the EasyEDA Pro front end are all relative to the canvas origin;
remarks.text.1: The EasyEDA Pro API uses the data origin;
remarks.text.2:
If the returned data is `{ canvasOriginOffsetX: 100, canvasOriginOffsetY: 200 }`,
it means the canvas origin is at a position 100 units to the right and 200 units up from the data origin;
remarks.text.3: The units here are data-level units, which are equivalent to mil on the canvas level in span
returns: The offset coordinate of the canvas origin relative to the data origin
